title: Trace of powers as the eigenvalue power sum
statement:
Let $K$ be an algebraically closed field, $V$ a finite-dimensional $K$-vector space, $r=\dim_KV$, and $A:V\to V$ a $K$-linear endomorphism. Use the characteristic polynomial $\chi_A(T)=\det(T-A\mid V)$ of [def-weil-characteristic-polynomial] and the ordinary linear trace of [def-weil-endomorphism-trace]. The multiset of roots of $\chi_A$ has cardinality $r$. If these roots, with algebraic multiplicity, are enumerated as $\alpha_1,\ldots,\alpha_r$, then for every integer $n\ge0$,
$$\operatorname{Tr}(A^n\mid V)=\sum_{j=1}^r\alpha_j^n.$$
No semisimplicity assumption on $A$ is made; for $r=0$ the sum is empty.
